```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)

payload <- jsonlite::fromJSON(params$payload_json, simplifyVector = FALSE)
esc_html <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L || is.na(x)) return("")
  s <- as.character(x)
  s <- gsub("&", "&amp;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("<", "&lt;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub(">", "&gt;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub('"', "&quot;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s
}
```

## Audit Summary

```{r header, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(
  "<p><strong>Project:</strong> %s &nbsp;|&nbsp; <strong>Plots Audited:</strong> %d &nbsp;|&nbsp; <strong>Total Findings:</strong> %d</p>\n",
  esc_html(payload$project),
  as.integer(payload$plotCount),
  as.integer(payload$issueCount)
))
```

```{r summary_counts}
if (!is.null(payload$categoryCounts) && length(payload$categoryCounts) > 0L) {
  c_rows <- lapply(payload$categoryCounts, function(r) {
    data.frame(
      Category = as.character(r$category),
      Errors = as.integer(r$errors),
      Warnings = as.integer(r$warnings),
      Total = as.integer(r$total),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, c_rows), caption = "Findings by Validation Domain")
}
```

## Detailed Findings

```{r issues_tbl}
if (!is.null(payload$issues) && length(payload$issues) > 0L) {
  i_rows <- lapply(payload$issues, function(r) {
    data.frame(
      PlotNumber = as.character(r$plotNumber),
      Category = as.character(r$category),
      Rule = as.character(r$rule),
      Severity = as.character(r$severity),
      Detail = as.character(r$detail),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, i_rows))
} else {
  cat("Zero validation or LMH25 pedological issues detected.")
}
```
